text:
Priya: Heads-up: conference booth dry-run tomorrow 10am. Main goals: finalize swag manifest, confirm speaker slide uploads, test QR->form->routing, and lock webinar follow-up cadence. Who's available?

Ethan: I'll be there for setup. Venue contact confirmed power on north wall only. We'll need to flip the banner layout to face the entrance.

Tess: Thanks 60a4bb. Can someone confirm exact banner dimensions? I have two art variants; want to avoid reprints.

Ethan: Banner area is 8ft x 3ft. Also no freestanding racks allowed on the carpeted area per venue rules.

Clara: Speakers: 2 confirmed, 2 backup. Ask them to upload slides to the shared drive by Mon 5pm. I'll send a reminder with the teleprompter notes.

Omar: Lead flow: QR -> short form -> FormsBot webhook -> Sales Ops. Let's use 'interest_tier' (low/medium/high) and 'company_domain' to route. High -> immediate Slack DM to oncall rep; medium -> weekly lead batch; low -> nurture.

Priya: Agreed. FormsBot, can you simulate a high-interest payload?

FormsBot: Simulated payload ready for test: {"email":"test+hq@company.com","interest_tier":"high","company_domain":"company.com","source":"booth_qr_2026"}

Clara: Perfect. Omar, add rule: enterprise domains (company.com, corp, inc) get enterprise tag and enterprise drip.

Omar: Noted. I'll push rules to Segment and set a webhook to PagerDuty for immediate followup when interest_tier==high.

LogiBot: Swag inventory check: enamel pins: 300, stickers: 400, polo shirts: 70 (S/M/L), hoodies: 40, chargers: 25, tote bags: 150. Back-ordered: 50 polos ETA Tue.

Priya: Costume decision: polos for staff only, tees for giveaways. Remove price tags from samples. Tess, can you add a small QR sticker on the polos for staff to demonstrate demo signup?

Tess: Yep. I4cc I'll create a 1in round QR sticker mock and share by EOD.

Ethan: Logistics hitch: customs flagged our EU swag pallet. ETA delayed 48h unless we provide HS codes and invoice copy. Who has that?

Priya: I have invoices. I'll DM the freight forwarder and upload HS codes to the portal now.

Clara: Webinar tie-in: attendees who check "send webinar" on the form auto-enroll to the post-event webinar (48h after event). Variant testing: Subject A = "See our inference stack in action" vs Subject B = "Cut inference cost with smart routing". We'll A/B by source param (demo vs booth).

Omar: Sales wants the subject lines swapped for enterprise leads. Add override in the routing logic.

Priya: Done. Also decision: follow-up cadence = 24h thank-you email, 48h webinar invite, 7d case study, 21d sales outreach. Approve?

Clara: Approve. I'll draft the thank-you + webinar email and share copy by Mon.

Ethan: Booth rota: Priya 9:30-12, Tess 11:30-2, Clara 1:30-4, Omar will shadow demos 12-3. Need one more volunteer for 3-6pm.

Tess: I can extend to 5:30 if needed.

Priya: Great. Also AV: bring HDMI->USB-C dongle and a small USB hub. I'll label cables.

LogiBot: Vendor pickup scheduled Mon 3pm: pick list includes 50 polos, 150 stickers, 20 chargers, 150 tote bags. Delivery manifest will be emailed to Ethan.

Ethan: For the dry-run please bring printed QR (2x) and a tablet with offline form cached. Venue wifi has a captive portal.

FormsBot: Note: offline caching uses localStorage; ensure browser permissions. Any schema changes require 24h to propagate.

Priya: Blocking items: customs docs, speaker slide uploads, last-minute volunteer. If no blockers by EOD, freeze and we run the webhook smoke test Tue 9am PT. Acks?

Clara: Ack.

Tess: Ack.

Ethan: Ack.

Omar: Ack.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll post final checklist after the dry-run and attach the QR files for print.
